blurb.en: Ravikīrti's praśasti of Pulakeśin II, dated 634-35 CE: his conquests, and Harṣa turned back.
blurb.hi: पुलकेशिन् द्वितीय की रविकीर्ति-रचित प्रशस्ति, 634-35 ई.: उनकी विजयें, और हर्ष का लौटना।

page.en: F. Kielhorn, Aihole Inscription of Pulikesin II (1901), p. 3
page.hi: F. Kielhorn, Aihole Inscription of Pulikesin II (1901), पृ. 3

verse: yena cb=akari Harshah (read: yena chākāri Harshaḥ)
